title: 第二百二十六章 妈妈回来啦第二百二十五章 开开心心过大年
slug: 新婚夜反杀家暴男极品全家求我别疯
content_zh:
“顾大姐，这家里乱还没来得及收拾，你自己找个地方坐哈！”晓彤妈倒了杯水端过来。
顾春花坐在沙发上，呷了口水，“不用忙活了，装好行李咱就走吧！”
“诶，已经装好了！”
“走着！”顾春花拉起晓彤的手，一行人锁好门便叫了辆车，直奔机场去了。
出租车开出市区，顾春花抬起头凝望自己生活了7年的城市，心里跟这座城道别。
再见了花城，今后她可能永远也不会再来了。
她要感谢这座城市，给她提供一个庇护所，还能让她赚到很多钱。
心里就算不舍，但这里永远也不是她的家。
一晃到了大年三十这天，何浅浅起得很早，招呼铁柱出去放一挂鞭炮。
何常勇已经把对联和福字贴上了，魏红红去厨房帮刘大爷和面拌馅。
杨大娘则是回到自己铺子，打算多做点卤肉，这过完年浅浅那边迎来送往肯定会来不少客人。
多准备点卤肉也能下酒。
雪琪和小翠也没闲着，擦擦扫扫的，把铺子里里外外拾掇得很干净。
就连春芽也学乖了，去后院抱了一小捆柴火送进厨房，刘爷爷说了，炉火不旺的话，就煮不熟饺子。
何浅浅倒是很闲，陪陆铮坐在大厅的桌子前下象棋。
“傅爷爷那边是一个人过年吗？”何浅浅放下一个棋子，随口问道。
陆铮盯着棋盘点点头，“傅奶奶走得早，这些年一直是爷爷一个人过春节！”
他知道这丫头想说什么，只要她点头，他现在就可以开车把傅爷爷接到店里来。
果不其然，何浅浅直接收了所有棋子，“不能让傅爷爷自己过年，那么大的房子空荡荡的，连做饭阿姨都回家过大年了，你去把傅爷爷接过来吧，大伙儿聚在一起也能热闹热闹！”
毕竟是大年三十了，哪能让老爷子一个人过年呢。

陆铮抿嘴笑笑，拍拍衣服站起身，“好，我去去就回！”
“你尽量快点哈，我妈他们也要下飞机了！”何浅浅催促道。
“你这是把我当成免费跑腿的了？”陆铮笑着吐槽。
何浅浅翻了个大白眼，“不乐意呀，你现在后悔还来得及！”
其实陆铮今年本可以留在省城家里，陪他爸妈一起过年的。
“乐意至极，等着！”
傅老爷子这会儿正在家里下挂面条呢，过年这段时间家里没人做饭，冰箱里只有挂面条和速冻饺子，饿了就对付一口。
这节骨眼上家家户户都忙着包饺子贴对联，他也不好去老战友家打扰他们。
自己的儿子和闺女一个在国外工作，一个在南方上班，都有自己的家庭，春节期间比他还忙，根本没时间回来。
“傅爷爷，忙着呐！”陆铮推开门，笑呵呵地走进来。
老爷子听到动静，轻哼道：“忙？我一天天都闲得长毛了，能忙啥？”
“哟，大过年的哪能吃挂面条呢，走走走，浅浅叫您去店里......”
‘过年’两个字还没说出来，老爷子已经把棉衣棉鞋穿好了，背着手往出走。
还是浅丫头最有良心了。
陆铮简直是哭笑不得，“傅爷爷，您还没锁门呐！”
“帮我锁上！”老爷子已经拉开车门上车了。
陆铮无奈地摇摇头，锁好门直接回铺子去了。
按照北春的习俗，三十晚上那顿饭才是最正式、最丰盛的，所以中午大伙儿就简单吃一口，把晚上的吃食都提前弄好，省得到时候慌乱。
content_en:
"Sister Gu, we haven't had time to clean up the mess in this house. Find a place to sit by yourself!" Xiaotong's mother poured a glass of water and brought it over.
Gu Chunhua sat on the sofa and took a sip, "No need to work anymore, just pack your luggage and let's go!"
"Hey, it's already installed!"
"Let's go!" Gu Chunhua took Xiaotong's hand, and the group locked the door, called a car, and went straight to the airport.
As the taxi drove out of the city, Gu Chunhua raised her head and stared at the city where she had lived for seven years, saying goodbye to this city in her heart.
Goodbye Huacheng, she may never come again in the future.
She wants to thank the city for giving her a sanctuary and allowing her to make a lot of money.
Even though she feels reluctant to let go, this place will never be her home.
On New Year's Eve, He Qianqian got up very early and asked Tie Zhu to go out and set off a firecracker.
He Changyong had already pasted up the couplets and the characters "福", and Wei Honghong went to the kitchen to help Uncle Liu mix the noodles and stuffing.
Aunt Yang returned to her shop, planning to cook more braised pork. After the Chinese New Year, Qian Qian would definitely have a lot of customers there.
Prepare more braised pork to go with wine.
Xue Qi and Xiao Cui were not idle either, cleaning and cleaning the shop inside and out.
Even Chun Ya learned the lesson and went to the backyard to bring a small bundle of firewood to the kitchen. Grandpa Liu said that if the fire is not strong, the dumplings will not be cooked.
He Qianqian was quite free, sitting at the table in the hall with Lu Zheng and playing chess.
"Is Grandpa Fu celebrating the New Year alone?" He Qianqian put down a chess piece and asked casually.
Lu Zheng stared at the chessboard and nodded, "Grandma Fu left early. Grandpa has been spending the Spring Festival alone these years!"
He knew what this girl wanted to say. As long as she nodded, he could drive Grandpa Fu to the store now.
As expected, He Qianqian directly collected all the chess pieces, "We can't let Grandpa Fu celebrate the New Year by himself. Such a big house is empty. Even the cooking aunts have gone home to celebrate the New Year. Go and pick up Grandpa Fu. It can be lively when everyone gets together!"
After all, it's New Year's Eve, how can the old man celebrate the New Year alone.
Lu Zheng pursed his lips and smiled, patted his clothes and stood up, "Okay, I'll be right back!"
"Hurry up as much as possible, my mother and the others are about to get off the plane too!" He Qianqian urged.
"Do you think of me as a free errand?" Lu Zheng complained with a smile.
He Qianqian rolled her eyes, "I'm not happy about it, you still have time to regret it now!"
In fact, Lu Zheng could have stayed at home in the provincial capital this year to celebrate the New Year with his parents.
"I'm extremely happy to wait!"
Mr. Fu is hanging noodles at home right now. No one at home is cooking during the Chinese New Year period. There are only noodles and quick-frozen dumplings in the refrigerator, so he can take a bite when he's hungry.
At this juncture, every household was busy making dumplings and posting couplets, and it was not good for him to disturb his old comrades at their homes.
His son and daughter, one working abroad and the other working in the south, both have their own families. They were busier than him during the Spring Festival and had no time to come back.
"Grandpa Fu, you're busy!" Lu Zheng opened the door and walked in with a smile.
When the old man heard the commotion, he hummed and said, "Busy? I'm so idle every day, what can I be busy with?"
"Hey, how can you eat noodles during the Chinese New Year? Let's go, Qianqian asked you to go to the store..."
Before the word "New Year" could be uttered, the old man had already put on his cotton-padded clothes and shoes, and walked out with his hands behind his back.
Qian girl is still the most conscientious.
Lu Zheng was dumbfounded, "Grandpa Fu, you haven't locked the door yet!"
"Lock it for me!" The old man had already opened the door and got in the car.
Lu Zheng shook his head helplessly, locked the door and went back to the shop.
According to Beichun custom, the meal on the thirtieth night is the most formal and sumptuous meal, so everyone has a simple bite at noon and prepares the evening meal in advance to avoid panic.
